interpretation: The old 50-step benchmark counted operations and collapses, but did not decrypt per step. The repeated-square route fails at depth 4 in both secure tuples. A zero-fresh-error ciphertext with a nontrivial c1 term also fails at depth 4, while the c1=0 control passes. Observed K widths are below the anchor reconstruction widths. These observations narrow the defect but do not by themselves identify the first erroneous scale-round coefficient or prove a complete noise bound. The separate mul-by-1 depth test has a different input history.
